rounds.verdict: Coherent and clean, but essentially a timid push-in — the podium rise that should express the Perth triumph is not visibly legible against the background.
filmIssues: The move reads as a plain centred push-in: across all six frames the lifter only gets gradually larger, with no clearly legible rise of the lifter-and-podium group against the tiled hall.

The claimed triumph rise is masked by the camera pan and zoom — the podium drifts toward the lower frame rather than visibly elevating, so the story beat (podium triumph at Perth) is not expressed beyond magnification.

Lifter and podium are correctly locked together (same depth, drift and scale) and the feet stay planted with no tearing, doubled edges, halo or painted-over ghost, but that also means there is almost no parallax storytelling within the group.

First frame is a clean full-plate opening and the last frame is a usable closer dwell image, neither clips awkwardly, and the light-sweep is subtle and era-appropriate — the problem is purpose, not coherence.
fixes: move damped to 75% (cut-2 10% off-frame at t=0.78)
